coatings.title: 2K Poly
coatings.description: A highly durable, industry-standard finish coating. Recommended for highest water and scratch resistance.

coatings.title: Natural Oil
coatings.description: A plant-based oil finish with a wide range of stain customization. Recommended for food-safe, sensitive, or user-maintenance applications.

sheens.title: Matte
sheens.description: Low reflection finish best for high-glare spaces.

sheens.title: Satin
sheens.description: Standard level for furniture. Maintains a "natural" look.

sheens.title: Gloss
sheens.description: Highest finish clarity, but highest light reflection and scratch visibility.

tints.title: Natural
tints.description: Maintain the raw wood color as closely as possible

tints.title: Darken
tints.description: Use a dark stain to tone the wood to your liking.

tints.title: Custom
tints.description: Match the stain to my reference
